summary: Iteration 13 tested 8 changes for GOD OF WAR guild app: podium toggle, alliance-name replacing Lv, header subtitle removal, BottomNav centering, Ungrouped palette, PointsList inline edit, Excel Sıralama sheet ranks. Fixed 2 leaderboard bugs (podium slot #2 still showed Lv, rest rows still showed '• Lv N'). Backend pytest: 2/2 passed. Frontend UI: all 8 acceptance criteria PASS after fix.
action_items: None — testing agent fixed the 2 discovered Leaderboard.jsx regressions inline (podium slot #2 alliance_name; removed '• Lv {r.level}' from rest rows).
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx still accepts an unused `subtitle` prop and callers (Members.jsx line 148, PointsList.jsx line 33) still pass it — dead code. Not blocking, but recommend removing prop + prop-drilling to keep the API clean.
Leaderboard.jsx line 156 previously used `Lv {top3[1].level}` for podium #2 while #1 and #3 used alliance_name — inconsistent code path. Testing agent unified all 3 slots to alliance_name.
Rest-row subtitle previously combined title || alliance || 'member' + ' • Lv {level}'. Requirement said alliance only; testing agent replaced with `r.alliance_name || t('member')`.
backend server.py Sheet 3 already correctly builds full_lb = scored + zero-point members and writes sequential idx 1..N in column A — verified via openpyxl (test passed).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (new pytest for PATCH /scores and Excel Sıralama sheet)
seed_data_creation: None needed — Gruplandırılmamış group already existed in prod data with the Palette button visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 13: 8 UI changes accepted end-to-end. Leaderboard now shows alliance_name in podium+rest (no Lv anywhere), podium-toggle collapses/expands correctly (aria-expanded flips true/false, podium-1 hidden when collapsed), PODYUM title gone, Header has no

subtitle on any of /, /komutanlar, /uyeler, /puanlar, /puan-ekle. BottomNav 6 tabs all have flex-col items-center justify-center text-center. Members Ungrouped group shows alliance-color-btn-Gruplandırılmamış and opens picker. PointsList shows edit-scorelist-{id} btn per row, opens scorelist-edit-dialog with points/save. Backend PATCH /api/scores/{id} works and Excel Sıralama Listesi sheet has sequential rank 1..N in column A with total row count == /api/members count.
rca of the issue: Two of the 8 changes were incompletely implemented in Leaderboard.jsx before testing: (a) podium slot index 1 (silver) was not updated when podium slot 0 (gold) and 2 (bronze) were switched from Lv → alliance_name; (b) the rest-row subtitle template was left untouched. Fix: replaced Lv-based JSX in both places with `alliance_name || '-'` (podium) and `alliance_name || t('member')` (rest rows).
